cases.note: a member of one group reaches that group's rule
modules:
package indexing

p := "devs" if data.groups.devs.members[input.subject]

p := "admins" if data.groups.admins.members[input.subject]

cases.note: a member of no group reaches no rule
modules:
package indexing

p := "devs" if data.groups.devs.members[input.subject]

p := "admins" if data.groups.admins.members[input.subject]

cases.note: in over an object in data tests its values, not its keys
modules:
package indexing

q contains "by-key" if input.subject in data.groups.devs.members

q contains "by-value" if input.role in data.groups.devs.members

cases.note: membership in an array in data is not indexed but still evaluates
modules:
package indexing

s := "devs" if input.subject in data.groups.devs.member_list

s := "admins" if input.subject in data.groups.admins.member_list

cases.note: a collection the data does not hold reaches no rule
a with statement replacing the collection is seen
modules:
package indexing

u if data.groups.devs.members[input.subject]
package indexing.caller

v if data.indexing.u with data.groups.devs.members as {"carol": true}

cases.note: a with statement may replace the collection with a set

result.description: the count of elements, key/val pairs, or characters, respectively.
result.name: n

cases.note: a set the subject is not in reaches no rule

result.description: the count of elements, key/val pairs, or characters, respectively.
result.name: n
